comment: Epimerizes Val4 and Ile12 of the precursor peptide EpeX to d-Val and d-allo-Ile, the only modifications required for epipeptide maturation.

reactions.description: epimerization of L-Ile12 to D-allo-Ile12 of the EpeX precursor peptide
First epimerization: Ile12 to d-allo-Ile. Only the Cα is inverted; the Cβ configuration is retained.
epimerization of L-Val4 to D-Val4 of the mono-epimerized EpeX precursor peptide
Second epimerization: Val4 to d-Val, acting on the mono-epimerized peptide.
